title: User preferences
description: How output is presented. A preference never alters measured evidence, a safety gate, a mode requirement or a tolerance. If one appears to, that is a defect and should be filed as one — the value of the evidence model rests on presentation and measurement being separable.

outputLanguage.description: Presentation language for generated prose. It does not translate evidence values, which stay as measured.

detailLevel.description: How much a human summary says. The machine-readable contract is unaffected and always complete — a terse summary must never mean a thinner result.

runOptionalFidelityChecks.description: Optional checks add evidence. They never relax a gate.

confirmBeforeOverwrite.description: When true, a destructive change requires an explicit confirmation or --force.

$kind.description: Preferences may only be a preference or a tool default. One claiming to be a project requirement would let presentation gate behaviour.
